item.title: Hero bus driver sacrificed his life to save 20 soldiers
item.description: Avshalom Revivo, 61, swerved his bus to protect 20 soldiers in a decision his employer believes saved their lives - but paid for it with his own life.

item.title: Why did Noah need such a big ark?
item.description: Noach had a duty not only to prepare for his own survival, but to give others the chance to save themselves. But there would never be enough room for that.

item.title: Parshat Noach | The teivah: Not in Turkey after all?
item.description: While the Torah places Noach's Ark on the mountains of Ararat, a closer look at the Rambam and Midrash suggests the ark may have ultimately come to rest near the future site of the Holy Temple.

item.title: The true loyalties of the Jews of Privilege
item.description: Anti-Zionist Jews will do anything to try to preserve their position in society but they are playing a losing game with the non-Jewish world. And their abysmal response to October 7 showed their fellow Jews all their cards. Opinion.

item.title: Not rocket science: New car hits the road - and the air
item.description: Elon Musk unveils Tesla's new Roadster with rocket-like thrusters, showcasing aerial stunts and acceleration from 0 to 60 mph in under a second. Production is targeted for 2028.

item.title: Brazil election poll: Pro-Israel Bolsonaro leads Lula by two points ahead of runoff
item.description: Flavio Bolsonaro leads Brazilian President Lula 47% to 45% in a new Datafolha poll ahead of the October 25 runoff, narrowing his previous four-point advantage.

item.title: Two years since Sinwar's elimination: IDF reveals his orders before October 7
item.description: Marking two years since Yahya Sinwar's elimination, the IDF releases a handwritten document in which the Hamas leader ordered terrorists to document atrocities on October 7.

item.title: Called Netanyahu a 'Qatari agent': PM to sue former close aide
item.description: After Yoav Horowitz accused Netanyahu of being a "Qatari agent," the Likud announces that the Prime Minister would file a 500,000-shekel defamation lawsuit.

item.title: Indonesia's Islamic council demands cancellation of Bocelli concerts over Israel
item.description: Indonesia's leading Islamic council calls for the cancellation of two Andrea Bocelli concerts, citing the Italian tenor's support for Israel and its military.

item.title: German court jails two men over Iranian plot to assassinate Jewish leaders
item.description: German court sentences two men for plotting attacks on prominent pro-Israel figures on behalf of Iran's Quds Force and conducting surveillance of Jewish targets.

item.title: Chinese FM to Herzog: Palestinian issue 'the greatest historical injustice of the century'
item.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi urges Israel to reverse Jewish community construction in Judea and Samaria and reaffirms Beijing's support for a Palestinian state.

item.title: CENTCOM rejects Iran's claims on Hormuz, cargo ship sinking and US deaths
item.description: US Central Command disputes Iranian claims of control over the Strait of Hormuz, the sinking of a Singapore-flagged ship and hundreds of American military deaths.

item.title: Three young children and a teacher killed in Oregon elementary school shooting
item.description: Three children - aged 5, 8, and 11 - and a teacher murdered in a shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon. Shooter, a 16-year-old, shot and killed.

item.title: China's Foreign Minister calls for Palestinian state during talks in Azerbaijan
item.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi reiterates Beijing's support for Palestinian statehood and a two-state solution.

item.title: Military service for all, Finance Ministry: Zelekha unveils economic plan, slams Netanyahu
item.description: Prof. Yaron Zelekha unveils his party's economic platform, declaring he will join only a Zionist government that supports universal military service and appoints him finance minister.

item.title: Trump rules out nuclear strike on Iran, says no plans for ground troops
item.description: President Trump says he will not use nuclear weapons against Iran and has no plans to deploy ground troops, amid reports of a possible MOAB strike.

item.title: Rubio to Lebanon's President: Confiscated explosives must not be returned to Hezbollah
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio urges Lebanon to hold those behind a Hezbollah explosives shipment accountable and warns against returning the seized weapons to the group.
